name: 01-game-paoyong
prompt:
Create a polished industrial-design concept sheet for a redesigned rotatable collectible model in HAOQI's personal portfolio. This is a visual proposal for approval, NOT a website screenshot, NOT an engineering certificate. Wide landscape canvas, very high resolution, quiet warm off-white studio background #F1F0EB, crisp museum-catalog typography, generous margins, precision PBR product rendering. Show THREE aligned ORTHOGRAPHIC exterior views of exactly the SAME object: FRONT at left, narrow SIDE in the middle, BACK at right. Equal object heights, coherent geometry, materials and physically plausible thickness in every view. Front and back are straight-on orthographic, side is a true 90-degree edge profile, NOT another perspective view. Large clear Chinese view labels “正面”, “侧面”, “背面”. No perspective hero, no exploded parts, no extra copies of the object. A small heading at top, four discreet sampled palette chips and short material notes at bottom. The model must look implementable as a modest real-time Three.js asset, with a strong category-specific silhouette, no decorative sci-fi plumbing, no circuit board, no spaceship hardware, no gigantic glass slab, no camera/turntable/extra props. Reference images are CONTENT INSERTS, not product shapes: preserve the supplied artwork's recognizable composition, characters and lettering wherever printed on the model; do not invent substitute art. The common design language across this series is precise edges, readable archive labels, a small removable paper catalog tab and subtle material joints. Content-derived color affects the object's frame or sleeve and accents, never a uniform global neon green. Keep labels sparse and accurately spelled.
TITLE “游戏光盘 / 泡涌”.
Object: a slim premium optical GAME DISC in a translucent lightly blue-tinted jewel case, roughly 142:125:10 proportions, visibly rectangular with slightly softened corners and one narrow hinge. It should be unmistakably a game disc, different from a vinyl record. The full-size optical disc is the dominant visible object on the FRONT behind optically CLEAR polymer; its outer rim is subtly iridescent silver, the center has a small real spindle hole, and a large circular printed label uses input image 1 (the cheerful blue jellyfish game icon). Disc occupies about 80 percent of the case front. No tiny thumbnail buried in a mechanical cassette. Edge tint is deep ocean blue #04346D with bright blue #096DB3 selective accents; quiet cream #F8E8D4 catalog tab, black #151916 fine labels. SIDE shows the actual thin blue transparent case seam and hinge. BACK has a dark blue paper sleeve printed prominently with input image 2, the full “泡涌” promotional artwork, fitted as an uncropped landscape artwork panel; bottom margin holds “泡涌” and “WORK-04 / GAME DISC”. Rear artwork faces outwards and text is not mirrored. Palette chips are #04346D, #096DB3, #F8E8D4 and silver. Small footer notes “透明聚碳酸酯 / 银色光盘 / 主题色取自作品”.

Do not invent camera model, extra photography, biography or fake coordinates. Object should read as a collector's photographic archive frame rather than a tablet device. Palette chips #49576C, #B18889, #F5CDB2 and warm ivory. Footer notes “阳极铝框 / 清透玻璃 / 无酸卡纸”.
